data.name: MoSimulator
data.detailed_description:
Get Behind the Glass of Your Favorite Robots 

MoSimulator is an arcade robotics game built around competitive student robotics. Pick a robot, and drive in games from various seasons.

Community Robots

Mosimulator's modding system lets players bring in real robots from past and present seasons. With our Unique modding SDK, we make importing your own team's robot easy, no matter how unique.

Local Multiplayer

Mosim Supports Local multiplayer for 1v1 and 2v0 Matches. This makes Mosimulator a great way to bring people together, whether it's for team bonding or to fill downtime at events.

  • 1v1 Split-Screen — race your opponent to score the most points

  • 2v0 Co-op — work together and create dynamic strategies

How it plays

Mosimulator plays true to real life with realistic swerve physics, custom interaction rollers, and game-piece physics.

Features

  • Teleop-only gameplay 

  • Ever-growing library of community robot mods

  • Unity-based modding pipeline with full CAD support

  • Physics-driven swerve and game piece interaction

  • Clean, colorful field visuals built for fast play

  • Local split-screen multiplayer

  • Shared Source Roots - Mosimulator is developed with a focus on community, ensuring the game and its community evolve around the real competition

Ready to compete? Pick a robot, try community mods, and climb the leaderboards.

data.short_description: MoSimulator is a robotics simulation game with an arcade feel that lets players mod in their own robots. Experience the excitement of competitive student robotics in a fun, accessible format where you can bring your own robot designs to life and compete in simulated matches.
